green.name: Village Green
green.description: The heart of {self.area}: a sloping green ringed by thatched cottages, their gardens bright with hollyhocks. Geese patrol the grass with the air of tax collectors.
green.brief: The village green, patrolled by geese.

features.//: Uses the tree from The Wilds if that mod is loaded.

inn.name: #inn_name#
inn.description: A low-beamed common room, warm and smoky, smelling of ale and woodsmoke. A fire crackles in a broad hearth and the floorboards complain at every step.

smithy.name: Smithy
smithy.description: Heat rolls out of the forge in waves. Tools hang from every beam: tongs, hammers, and things you can't name.

chapel.name: Chapel of the Well-Saint
chapel.description: A small, cool chapel of whitewashed stone. Light falls in coloured patches from a single stained-glass window showing a woman drawing water from a well.

cottage.name: Elder's Cottage
cottage.description: A cramped cottage crowded with a lifetime's belongings. Bundles of herbs hang drying from the rafters.

lane.name: Orchard Lane
lane.description: A lane runs between the village orchards and out toward open country. Apple trees lean over a drystone wall.
lane.brief: The orchard lane at the edge of the village.

gate.name: Village Gate
gate.description: A gap in the old palisade where the village ends and the wide world begins. The wooden gate stands propped open with a stone.

hamlet_call.title: A Call for Aid
hamlet_call.intro: Word has reached you that the village elder, {beat.elder.name}, has been asking after you.
hamlet_call.hint: Speak with {beat.elder.name} in the Elder's Cottage.
hamlet_call.complete_text: {beat.elder.Name} grips your hand. "Go carefully. And come back."
hamlet_call.hook: Strange things are stirring in {beat.area}, and the folk there are frightened.
